senses.gloss: f. ch. (= h. לְוָיָה) escort, reception on arriving and leaving.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> other people <he>דלית אלוויתיה שכיחא לון</he> (read … <he>תא</he>) who do not frequently meet with a reception (an offer of refreshments &c.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>דַּלְוַויָיתֵיה וכ׳</he> (= <he>דאל</he>) who may fairly expect a reception. Cmp. <cite ref="A01279"><he>אִילַּוָּיוּתָא</he></cite>.
